toString returns "LoggedGoal{..}" with scorer/ball positions, goal type (kick, cross, header) and match time.

Sprite subclass with per-pixel alpha, same as Sol Knight ArgbSprite.
Iterator over IterableNodeHashTable buckets.

Circular deque of IntrusiveNode with head and tail operations.

Abstract NetworkGameClient subclass that Kickabout extends and that declares the per-frame hooks.
Runnable that opens JAGGRAB requests and reads the reply into a PacketBuffer.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentGoalState" with two team scores, goal count and goal scorer.
Base class for the audio output backends, same shape as Sol Knight PcmPlayerService.
Int-pixel sprite with blit methods, same as Shattered Plans Sprite.
Stream over a decoded PcmSample, same as Ace of Skies PcmSampleStream.
Canvas with a Frame field that forwards focus events, same role as GeoBlox FullscreenFocusCanvas.
Extends com.ms.dll.Callback like Ace of Skies MicrosoftCursorController.
UiWidget that owns an IntrusiveDeque of child widgets and routes events to them.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentLineup" with per-participant lineup slots.
ArchiveSource subclass that caches fetched groups, same as Sol Knight CachedArchiveSource.
MatchAgent whose toString prints "AgentFormation" with per-team formation choices.
Request object with volatile status and result, same as GeoBlox PlatformTask.

namingTool.adaptation: Resolve named member/local class binary prefixes from javac declaration simple names, preserving local ordinals and dollar characters. Compose containing-class renames recursively, including untouched top-level dollar names. Constructors, owner/type descriptors, literal loading, lexical labels and all bindings are recompiled and verified; output collisions fail before publication.
